name: @playliquid/platform-economy
description: PlayLiquid GameOS rewards/economy platform authority service (PL-017). Games declare eligible semantic events via SettlementEligibilityDeclaration admission (total-validated, duplicate-refusing typed conflicts); the PLATFORM owns validation, entitlements and settlement: an entitlement ledger of grants/balances/holds/settlements scoped by tenant+subject (E1 single owner), deterministic settlement over @playliquid/platform-contracts oracles (validateSettlement, settleGrant, settleLedgerEntry, admitLifecycleCommand, admitSettlement) with event-keyed idempotency (E9/E10: a completed settlement never re-applies; replays return the recorded receipt), the RewardIntegrityPort seam consulted before settlement (PL-018 wired by the host later — evidence/confidence only, never a verdict, R11), and an EconomyValueResolver port for digest-pinned magnitudes (zero numeric authority in contracts). Tenant isolation with least-privilege grants (R20), anti-abuse refusals negatively tested (E8). Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner; persistence, time, integrity evidence and value resolution live behind ports with in-memory fakes; no IO, no timers, no globals.
